subject: Pricing follow-up: startup program + committed-use options (Novaflow)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + pricing targets (Novaflow)

Hi Samir — great to meet today, and thanks for the thoughtful product overview. Short recap and next steps from our side: 

Summary from the call:
- Expected volume (year 1): ~50M tokens/month (embeddings), ~30M tokens/month (chat/completions).
- Growth plan: ~3x by year 2 (roughly 150M embeddings, 90M chat).
- Procurement/budget: you mentioned an initial monthly budget band of $10k-$25k with appetite to convert to a committed plan if unit economics look good.
- Key ask: you're targeting a blended unit economics target (roughly what you'd like to pay per 1M tokens) so we can draft committed-use options that meet your ROI threshold.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Can you confirm the token split (embeddings vs chat) and whether the volumes we captured are monthly or are seasonal peaks?
2) Share the incumbent/vendor unit cost (rough ballpark is fine) so we can calibrate the commitment level and discount bands.
3) Decide whether to pursue the Redwood startup program (if eligible) or a committed-use (monthly/annual) discount — we can model both.

I attached a short pricing tiers sheet and a draft term sheet (see attachments). For transparency, high-level possibilities we can model quickly:
- Startup program: one-time credit + 50–60% off list for 6–12 months (if eligible).
- Committed-use (12 mo): tiered discounts based on committed spend; e.g., 20–35% standard, 35–50% for higher multi-year/commit.
- Multi-year incentives: additional 5–10% for 2+ year commitments + upfront payment.

If you can reply with a confirmed monthly split and the approximate incumbent unit cost by end of day tomorrow, I’ll run three scenarios (startup credit, 12-month commit, 24-month commit) and send back modeled $/1M token blended numbers. 

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Samir Desai <samir@novaflow.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + pricing targets (Novaflow)

Ben — thanks for the recap and the clear next steps. Confirmations below and a couple of clarifying questions.

Confirmations:
- Volumes: the numbers you captured are monthly averages (not seasonal peaks). Year 1 is conservative.
- Current vendor cost: we pay roughly $140/1M tokens (blended across embedding + chat) today; embeddings are cheaper, chat is the majority of cost.
- Procurement: they need explicit committed-use and multi-year options to evaluate — our budget team prefers predictable unit economics.

Clarifying items:
1) For the startup program — we are an early-stage company (Series A, < $5M ARR) — do we qualify?
2) For committed-use modeling, what blended $/1M tokens do you think is feasible for 12-month vs 24-month? Our target internal threshold is ~$80/1M blended to make this attractive vs our current vendor.

Looping in procurement separately: procurement@novaflow.ai for any PO/questions.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Desai
Head of ML Platform, Novaflow
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, procurement@novaflow.ai
Date: 2026-03-03T18:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + pricing targets (Novaflow)

Thanks Samir — helpful color. Short answers inline and a proposed pricing model.

1) Startup program: Yes — based on what you shared (Series A, ARR < $5M) you should qualify for the Redwood Early-Stage package. That gives: $50k in platform credits + preferential signup discounts for 6 months. I’ll confirm eligibility with our partner ops team but it’s likely.

2) Blended $/1M modeling (illustrative, see attached spreadsheet for full line items):
- List (hosted API): ~$200 / 1M tokens (blended)
- Startup program (first 6 months): effective blended ~$60–$90 / 1M (credit amortized + startup discount)
- 12-month committed-use (monthly invoiced):
  - Commit tier A (50M–250M/mo): 20% discount -> ~$160 / 1M
  - Commit tier B (250M–750M/mo): 35% discount -> ~$130 / 1M
  - Commit tier C (750M+/mo): 45% discount -> ~$110 / 1M
- 24-month commit / prepay: additional 8–12% off the 12-month pricing (so the ~110 level could get to ~$97–$101 / 1M depending on prepay).

Notes on unit economics: embeddings are typically 3–5x cheaper than chat on the same token basis in our catalog; blended numbers above assume your split where chat is the larger portion. If you want to hit the ~$80/1M blended target, a realistic path would be: 24-month commit with partial prepay + enrollment in the startup program credits for the first 6 months. That combo can bring blended to the $75–$90 range depending on final volumes and the chat/embedding ratio.

Next operational steps I propose:
- Marissa (CC) — can you confirm internal approval for startup credits and whether ops needs any SOC/compliance artifacts for Novaflow?
- Samir / procurement: if you are comfortable, share a short form SOW or target commit ($/month or $/yr) and I’ll return a formal quote and a redline-ready term sheet.

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_tiers_v2.xlsx (pricing scenarios), Redwood_term_sheet_2026.pdf (draft).

If procurement wants to jump on a quick 20-min call tomorrow to speed PO, I can make time.

Thanks — Ben
From: procurement@novaflow.ai <procurement@novaflow.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + pricing targets (Novaflow)

Ben / Marissa — procurement here. We appreciate the scenarios; a few quick asks to move forward: 
1) Please provide a short master services order (MSO) and a sample invoice schedule for the 24-month prepay option.
2) Confirm whether the startup credits are applied as an offset on invoices or issued as a one-time credit note.
3) We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a data processing addendum (DPA) included in the contract pack.

If you can send the MSO + invoice schedule + SOC 2 link today, we can circulate internally and aim to give a go/no-go by Friday.

Procurement - Novaflow
